newsitem.title: INDIA: India Tata Tea down 5 pct before results.
newsitem.headline: India Tata Tea down 5 pct before results.

text.p: Shares of Tata Tea slipped 9.75 rupees or 4.7 percent to 197.50 rupees on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) ahead of first half results expected later on Thursday, traders said.
Tata Tea shares have fallen 12 percent on the BSE this week.
Tea analysts say the firm's net profit for the six months to September 30, 1996 is likely to be flat despite an increase in turnover.
They say first half sales -- which rose 48 percent during April-July 1996 -- are likely to be higher than the year ago.
But a fall in "other income" could pull net profit lower, analysts said.
"The company is consciously restructuring its business to reduce its dependence on non-operational income," said an analyst at a European securities firm.
"Other income is a real wild card in Tata Tea," another analyst said.
Tata Tea's net profit for the six months ended September 30, 1995 was 312.5 million rupees with other income at 165 million rupees.
The firm is among the world's largest tea firms and part of the business house of the Tatas.
